analytic_vs_swbpipe.note: closed-form Euler-Bernoulli witness against SWBPIPE's Euler-Bernoulli frame: binary64 round-off scale

external.note: relative 0.5 %; absolute floors cover the rounding of the external prover's printed values

caepipe_print_resolution.note: alternative analytic against the external prover: half a unit of its printed resolution (forces 1 N, moments 1 N*m, displacements 0.001 mm, rotations 0.0001 deg) plus binary64-scale relative 1e-6; the tightest tolerance the printed values can resolve

tolerances.basis_note: ASSUMPTION: pilot tolerance chosen by the implementer for the proof of concept; the governed external-oracle tolerance class is TBD (owner ruling); never loosened to match CAEPIPE

declared_differences.description: Shear deformation: SWBPIPE's frame preview is Euler-Bernoulli; the CAEPIPE technical reference describes a pipe stiffness matrix with a transverse shear flexibility term. The alternative analytic is the Timoshenko value (Euler-Bernoulli plus the shear term) with shape factor 2, kappa = 0.5 (ASSUMPTION).

alternative_analytic.assumption: ASSUMPTION: Timoshenko shear coefficient kappa = 0.5, i.e. shape factor 2 in the shear flexibility shape factor x L / (G A) (thin-wall circular tube); the CAEPIPE technical reference names the shape-factor term without a value (docs.sstcae.com tech_manual, Fiber Reinforced Plastic Piping (FRP), Stiffness matrix); its CAEPIPE value is a question for SST (CQ-17-01-010)

source_basis.title: CAEPIPE Technical Reference Manual, Fiber Reinforced Plastic Piping (FRP)
source_basis.supports: paraphrased, not quoted: the pipe stiffness matrix is formed from an axial flexibility L/EA, a transverse shear flexibility (a shape factor times L/GA), a bending flexibility L/EI and a torsional flexibility L/2GI; no shape-factor value is published, and the page is the FRP chapter (its use for the steel pipe element is an inference for SST to confirm, CQ-17-01-010)
